title: imap config: ImapConfig struct and TOML loading
description: Create crates/imap/src/config.rs. Define: struct ImapConfig { listen: ListenConfig, tls: TlsConfig, auth: usenet_ipfs_auth::AuthConfig, database: DatabaseConfig, limits: LimitsConfig, log: LogConfig }. struct ListenConfig { addr: String }. struct TlsConfig { cert_path: Option<String>, key_path: Option<String> }. struct DatabaseConfig { path: String (default 'imap.db'), pool_size: u32 (default 4) }. struct LimitsConfig { max_connections: usize (default 200), command_timeout_secs: u64 (default 30), max_message_bytes: u64 (default 26214400 = 25MB) }. struct LogConfig { level: String (default 'info'), format: String (default 'text') }. impl ImapConfig { pub fn from_file(path: &Path) -> Result<Self, String> { read file, toml::from_str, map_err } pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), String> { check TLS cert+key both set or both absent; check listen addr parses as SocketAddr } }. All structs #[derive(Debug, Deserialize)], all defaults via #[serde(default = "func_name")].
